Som preciso para localização espacial em jogos
Comunicação clara com microfone integrado
Isolamento acústico passivo
Conforto prolongado para maratonas de jogos

item.title_tr: QKZ AK6 Professional Gaming Headset with Mic - Powerful Bass 10mm Impedance 16Ω, Splash Resistant
item.description_tr:
QKZ AK6 Gaming Headset - Details Page
🌟 Welcome to Our Store!
Get ready to elevate your audio experience with the QKZ AK6 headphones! The perfect companion for gamers and music lovers looking for exceptional sound quality.
📌 Product introduction
QKZ AK6 are professional in-ear headphones that offer:
High quality surround sound
Ergonomic and comfortable Design
Built-in microphone for communication
Passive noise cancellation
Volume control on cable
10mm dynamic Drivers for powerful bass
🏡 Usage Scenarios
Games: Capture all the sound details of the game
Music: Enjoy your playlist with premium quality
Sports: Safe Design for physical activities
Work: Ideal for calls and conferences
Day by day: Perfect companion for everyday use
📊 Technical Specifications
Brand: QKZ
Model: AK6
Type: Wired In-Ear
Driver: Dynamic 10mm
Sensitivity: 105±3dB
Impedance: 16Ω ±15%
Frequency response: 20-20,000Hz
Connector: P2 (3.5mm)
Cable length: 1.2m + 3cm extension
Microphone: Yes
Controls: On-cable volume control
Waterproof: Splash resistant (do not submerge)
🎮 Features for Gamers
Precise sound for spatial location in games
Clear communication with built-in microphone
Passive acoustic isolation
Prolonged comfort for game marathons
🛡️ WARRANTY AND SUPPORT
Warranty against manufacturing defects
Specialized technical support
Customer service via chat
Instruction Manual included
⚠️ Important Information
Do not submerge in water
Store in the case provided when not in use
Clean regularly with a dry cloth
Test different rubbers for better fit
Compatible with most 3.5mm devices
💡 Why choose QKZ AK6?
✅ High Fidelity Sound
✅ Prolonged comfort
✅ Built-in Microphone
✅ Excellent value for money
✅ Ideal for games and music
✅ Complete Kit with Accessories
Take your audio to another level with the QKZ AK6!
Thank you for your preference! 🎧
